item.title: Wojood - Arabic NER
item.description: Wojood consists of about 550K tokens (MSA and dialect) that are manually annotated with 21 entity types (e.g., person, organization, location, event, date, etc). It covers multiple domains and was annotated with nested entities. The corpus contains about 75K entities and 22.5% of which are nested. A nested named entity recognition (NER) model based on BERT was trained (F1-score 88.4%).

item.title: Comprehend Medical
item.description: Amazon Comprehend Medical is a HIPAA-eligible natural language processing (NLP) service that uses machine learning that has been pre-trained to understand and extract health data from medical text, such as prescriptions, procedures, or diagnoses.
